# Telegram Mini Apps SDK snapshot

`telegram-web-app.js` is a snapshot of Telegram's official
`https://telegram.org/js/telegram-web-app.js?63`, fetched on 2026-10-06.
SHA-256: `3549138a7934039fe7dfd1291a4ee739bd2b705a614308053a8b08a87d85c451`.

It is served from the game's own origin so the Mini App does not depend on a
second host to finish parsing its HTML. Review and refresh this snapshot when
updating Telegram Mini Apps support. Telegram's public SDK repository is
`https://github.com/TelegramMessenger/TGMiniAppsJsSDK`; its MIT license is in
`telegram-web-app.LICENSE`.
